newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo Nobel sees better 1997 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Akzo Nobel sees better 1997 earnings.

text.p: Chemicals group Akzo Nobel NV said on Thursday it expected higher net income in 1997.

"Akzo Nobel foresees continued moderate and fairly stable growth in our most important markets. In our other markets we expect economic conditions to remain substantially the same. Based on this scenario, we expect a higher net income," it said in a statement.
It said sales would be roughly the same as in 1996, despite some important deconsolidations in 1997 which would include Salt America.
Akzo earlier announced 1996 year net profit of 1.318 billion guilders on turnover of 22.44 billion guilders.
